assets.title: Welcome path
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: individual full-bleed opaque wide 2:1 screen hero for CircleU. Reference image is the exact Pingu character identity and rendering style, not the composition: navy penguin, white face and tummy, oval dark eyes, single curved crest, small orange beak and orange feet, light blue scarf. Clean softly dimensional matte illustration, contemporary, gently warm, not sketchy, not glossy plastic, no heavy outlines or grain. Palette ice-white, powder blue, navy, cobalt accent, restrained peach sunlight. Keep anatomy as two flippers and two feet, no human fingers. Calm expressions appropriate to adults working through conversations. No words, lettering, numbers, logos, UI, borders, watermarks or collages. One coherent scene. Spacious uncluttered composition with the whole character visible; preserve generous margins. Distinct scene and action, no cave, lantern, floating ice or sunset lake. 2:1 aspect ratio.
Scene: Pingu walks along a gently curving pale-blue path in a peaceful stylised garden, carrying a closed cobalt notebook tucked under one flipper and making a small welcoming wave with the other. Place Pingu in the central third, feet visible, three-quarter front view, gentle breeze lifts scarf end. Rounded powder-blue shrubs and two sculptural small trees frame the edges, subtle peach morning sun beyond, quiet broad sky in upper third. An inviting scene of beginning at your own pace, no other characters, signs or architecture.
